question: Show the month-over-month change in total requests for 2025 (month, requests, change from previous month).
pred_sql:
WITH monthly_requests AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS requests
    FROM 
        v_requests
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)
),
previous_month_requests AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS requests
    FROM 
        v_requests
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024 AND 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM monthly_requests))
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)
),
monthly_change AS (
    SELECT 
        mr.month,
        mr.requests,
        COALESCE(pm.requests, 0) AS previous_month_requests,
        ROUND(100.0 * (mr.requests - pm.requests) / pm.requests, 1) AS change_from_previous_month
    FROM 
        monthly_requests mr
    LEFT JOIN 
        previous_month_requests pm ON mr.month = pm.month
)
SELECT 
    month,
    requests,
    change_from_previous_month
FROM 
    monthly_change
ORDER BY 
    month
